name: Allan Sharrock
bio: Allan Sharrock is a highly experienced New Zealand trainer based in New Plymouth, Taranaki. Known for his ability to develop horses efficiently and place them to advantage, Allan has built a strong reputation for getting the best out of his horses. His patient, horse-first approach makes him an ideal trainer for young stock.

name: Bjorn Baker
bio: Bjorn Baker is one of the most in-form and exciting trainers in Sydney, coming off a $2 million ATC Derby victory with Green Spaces. Success at the elite level runs in the family, with his father training five individual Derby winners in Australia. Based at Warwick Farm, Bjorn targets both Sydney metropolitan and Melbourne carnival races.

name: Inspire Racing
bio: Inspire Racing is a New Zealand-based syndicator focused on making racehorse ownership accessible and transparent. They offer shares with capped management fees and full cost transparency, publishing per-share pricing and monthly costs upfront. Inspire partners with leading trainers including Te Akau, Allan Sharrock, and Bjorn Baker (Sydney).

name: Sam Mynott
bio: Sam Mynott Racing is a Cambridge-based syndicator offering both buy-in and monthly fee syndication models. Known as the 'Rose Syndicate' model, Sam offers a proven structure with set monthly ongoing fees. Active at Karaka Yearling Sales with a focus on value buys from respected studs including Windsor Park and Wentwood Grange.

name: Stephen Gray
bio: Stephen Gray operates Copper Belt Lodge, a boutique training facility based in Cambridge in the heart of New Zealand's Waikato thoroughbred country. Known for his patient, horse-first approach, Stephen has built a reputation for developing young horses into competitive racetrack performers. His hands-on management style and attention to each horse's individual needs ensure that every thoroughbred in his care receives the time and preparation needed to reach their full potential. With a focus on building long-term racing careers rather than quick results, Stephen Gray Racing provides an ideal environment for Evolution Stables' developing athletes.

name: Wexford Stables
bio: Wexford Stables is one of New Zealand's most iconic racing operations, established in 1961 by Hall of Fame trainer Dave O'Sullivan. Now led by Lance O'Sullivan ONZM and Andrew Scott, the stable continues a legacy of excellence from its world-class training facility in Matamata, the heartland of New Zealand thoroughbred racing. Lance O'Sullivan, a celebrated jockey-turned-trainer, has been a dominant force in New Zealand racing for decades, while Andrew Scott brings meticulous attention to detail and a hands-on training approach. Together, they have produced a consistent stream of Group race winners, including recent stars such as Gr.1 New Zealand Oaks winner Ohope Wins, Gr.1 Livamol Classic winner Waitak, and Gr.2 Manawatu Challenge winner Lux Libertas. Their proven record across all levels of racing, from maidens to elite-level feature events, makes Wexford Stables a trusted home for Evolution Stables' thoroughbreds.
